title: bug: JetBrains prior-handoff header reads from/to/createdAt, but the daemon writes releasedBy/releasedAt/reason, so every handoff box in Task Detail shows only "#N"
description:
Found by hunt task-2597ac6f (architect-1dd28c7c, finding F4). It was held back only because it shares MoeJson.kt, Models.kt and MoeJsonTest.kt with task-37e03b91. The governor filed it at 15:47Z on 2026-11-03 and accepts the overlap (worktree mode, merge-tree squash). The citations were re-checked at 946358a8.

PROBLEM. Task Detail's "prior handoffs" header never shows who released the task, when, or why. Every box reads just "#1", "#2" and so on. The JetBrains model expects keys the daemon never writes. The unit-test fixture encodes the wrong shape, so the suite stays green against a payload no daemon sends.

EVIDENCE (HEAD 946358a8).
- **Daemon:**
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts:553-571: HandoffNote is {whatIsDone, whatRemains, pitfalls?, openQuestions?, releasedBy?, releasedAt, reason?, diskState?};
  - tools/releaseTask.ts:150-156, 240-241 and 293-294 write it.
- **JetBrains:**
  - model/Models.kt:124-132: HandoffNote(from, to, createdAt, ...);
  - util/MoeJson.kt:512-528: parseHandoffs reads "from", "to" and "createdAt";
  - toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt:910-918: handoffBlocks builds the header from those three fields;
  - src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJsonTest.kt:419-427: the priorHandoffs fixture uses from/to/createdAt.
- **Repro:** /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/B/zzHunt2597B.wire.test.ts F3. A real release_task writes the handoff keys `reason, releasedAt, releasedBy, whatIsDone, whatRemains`, never from/to/createdAt (notes.md in the same folder).

FIX DIRECTION.
- Model and parse releasedBy, releasedAt and reason per schema.ts. Render the header as "#N released by <releasedBy> (<releasedAt>)", with the reason when one is present. A note missing them still renders "#N" without error.
- Fix the fixture to the daemon's shape, and add a case that fails if the parser reads from/to/createdAt again.
- **Out of scope:** the VS Code twin has the same shape bug (moe-vscode/src/types/moe.ts:202-210 HandoffNote, and TaskDetailPanel.ts around 1225). JetBrains goes first; do not edit VS Code in this row.

PLACEMENT (no dependsOn edge).
- task-37e03b91 (HIGH) edits Models.kt (PlanStep amendments), MoeJson.kt (step parse around 594-605), TaskDetailDialog.kt (step rendering) and MoeJsonTest.kt. task-40813cc1 edits ProjectSettings and parseProjectSettings.
- Keep this row's edits inside HandoffNote, parseHandoffs and handoffBlocks, and in the existing priorHandoffs fixture and its test method.
- Rebase on the target tip before landing if either peer has landed.
- Gradle runs only through cmd.exe gradlew.bat under the jetbrains-gradle lease. Hold the lease only around each run.
definitionOfDone: The JetBrains parser reads releasedBy, releasedAt and reason (schema.ts HandoffNote). Task Detail's handoff header shows the releaser and the release time, plus the reason when present. A note without them still renders "#N" without error.

MoeJsonTest's priorHandoffs fixture uses the daemon's shape (releasedBy/releasedAt/reason), and a test fails if the parser reads from/to/createdAt again. `gradlew.bat test` passes under the jetbrains-gradle lease. moe-vscode is untouched.
